subject: general
question: Who among the following was the first Home Minister of India?
solution: The correct answer is **__Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, popularly known as the Iron Man of India. • He was the **first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.** • He was instrumental in India's independence struggle, and then for the integration of over 500 princely states into the Union of India. • On the birth anniversary of Sardar Patel, on October 31, 2018, PM Modi unveiled the 'Statue of Unity' in Gujarat's Narmada district.
